rationale: The model correctly identifies the heap buffer overflow in the virtio-snd RX path. It accurately pinpoints the function and sink operation (AUD_read), identifies the guest-controlled period_bytes as the source of the overflow, and explains the root cause (missing bounds check against actual buffer capacity) in alignment with the ground truth for CVE-2024-7730.

The model accurately identifies the stack buffer overflow (CVE-2023-6693) in virtio-net. It correctly traces the source (guest-negotiated features affecting guest_hdr_len) to the sink (iov_to_buf writing into the undersized mhdr stack buffer). It also identifies the secondary impact on sg2[0].iov_len mentioned in the ground truth.
The model correctly identifies the snippet as a negative control. It accurately assesses that the newly added max_size guard acts as a proper boundary check, preventing the out-of-bounds write.
